Messages.Author: Michael Kelly
Messages.Body:
Is anyone up for a special game of JOL (Jyhad On Line) where the most
abusive/hated cards are banned. My idea is that each player can name
one card that will not be allowed in the game. Alternatively, each
player can name any number or up to a certain number of cards, but
the players vote on each to include or ban.

I for one would love to play a game where Thoughts Betrayed was
banned. I really, really, really hate that card.

For those of you wondering what JOL is, it is a on-line service
provided by George Fink that allows users to play jyhad over the
internet. He's up to over 30 games running now, many of which
have already completed.

So, how about it?
